public_API_review: Dispatch::new stores a scoped Arc and calls register_dispatch; NoSubscriber implements Default and returns never. The named local Dispatch is retained and never installed as a default.
reachable_failure_mechanism: The JustOne path consults the current calling thread instead of enumerating all registered scoped dispatchers; a first encounter on a no-default thread may cache never for a shared callsite.
reason_candidate_not_sufficient: An existing first-use registration can capture Rebuilder::JustOne before the second Dispatch is registered.
That JustOne operation does not hold the multi-dispatch registry read lock.
The candidate can register both dispatchers and rebuild the callsite interest while the older operation remains in flight.
The older operation may then read its own no-subscriber default and call set_interest(never) after the rebuild.
The cached-interest write has no registration epoch comparison; another rebuild or yield inside the test does not prove all older operations have drained.
next_candidate: Owned subprocess execution of the same original exact test, with original assertions, wait budget, full ordinary parent sharding, exact-one-child execution proof and failure/output/cleanup controls. This is fixture isolation, not an upstream tracing synchronization fix.
